sources.label: 議案の審査状況（令和8年第3回定例会）

name: 乳児通園支援の従事者に犯罪事実確認
summary: 条例に、乳児等通園支援事業者が児童対象性暴力等を防ぐための規定を加えます。事業者は、利用乳幼児に接する業務のうち、支配性・継続性・閉鎖性のある環境で接する従事者について、犯罪事実確認などを行い、性暴力等が起きた場合の保護に必要な措置を講じます。施行日は2026年12月25日です。
changes: 児童対象性暴力等を防ぐための必要な措置を事業者に義務付ける
支配性・継続性・閉鎖性のある環境で利用乳幼児に接する従事者について、犯罪事実確認などの必要な措置を講じる
性暴力等が起きた際の利用乳幼児の保護に必要な対応を事業者に義務付ける
who: 乳児等通園支援事業を利用する乳幼児
乳児等通園支援事業者と、利用乳幼児に接する対象従事者
why: 児童対象性暴力等の防止に関する法律の施行などに伴い、対象従事者の犯罪事実確認など必要な措置を定めるためと、区は説明しています。

notes: code: copied from the source (29 chars): 「児童対象性暴力等が行われた場合に利用乳幼児を適切に保護する」

en.name: Sets criminal record checks for infant attendance support workers
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Establishing Standards for Facilities and Operations of Itabashi City Infant and Other Child Attendance Support Services
en.summary: The ordinance adds requirements for providers of infant and other child attendance support services to prevent sexual violence, etc., against children. Providers must take measures, including criminal record checks, for workers whose duties bring them into contact with infants and young children using the service in settings involving control, continuity, and closedness. Providers must also take measures needed to protect children if sexual violence, etc., occurs. The ordinance takes effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Require providers to take necessary measures to prevent sexual violence, etc., against children
Require necessary measures, including criminal record checks, for workers who interact with infants and young children using the service in settings involving control, continuity, and closedness
Require providers to take necessary steps to protect infants and young children using the service if sexual violence, etc., occurs
who: Infants and young children who use infant and other child attendance support services
Providers of infant and other child attendance support services and the workers covered who interact with children using the service
en.why: The ward says this is to establish necessary measures, including criminal record checks for covered workers, in connection with the enforcement of the Act on Prevention of Sexual Violence against Children, etc.
